failure_summary.description: Calls repeatedly misplaced parameters, omitted or guessed constraints, used unsupported placeholders, or mapped values to the wrong schema fields.
Some trajectories omitted requested outcomes or added calls that did not serve a requested outcome.
A generic news search was chosen over an available endpoint dedicated to the requested content class.

patch.reasoning: Most argument and call-set errors are already covered by the skill's schema and outcome audits, so repeating those rules would not patch a gap. These edits sharpen endpoint choice when a specialized operation competes with a generic search and clarify that an explicit request for general item details remains distinct from requests for specialized attributes.

edits.target: - Treat endpoint eligibility as a gate: confirm the endpoint's own operation and schema support the requested result kind and granularity, and can represent every compatible explicit qualifier. A topical neighbor or broader operation is not sufficient. A named provider or source is a hard constraint for that outcome; do not fulfill or supplement it with another provider when a fitting named-source endpoint exists.
edits.content: - When both a task-specific endpoint and a generic search could return relevant items, prefer the task-specific endpoint if its documented operation matches the requested result class and constraints (for example, a movie-news search for movie news). Use the generic endpoint only when the specialized one cannot fulfill the outcome.

edits.target: - When several requested checks concern the same subject, first look for a single endpoint whose documented operation explicitly returns all the requested properties, and prefer it over multiple narrower calls when it fully covers the outcomes. Do not infer endpoint functionality from a provider-wide description or add a secondary validator whose result is already covered; split the checks only when no endpoint genuinely covers them together.
edits.content: - Treat an explicit request for general or comprehensive item details as an outcome in its own right, even when the user also names specialized details such as financing or recommendations. A specialized endpoint covers that general-detail outcome only if its documented operation explicitly returns it.
